summary: Accepted for source_digest sha256:d016efe5b64a27173a1fd30a1a388d103836db8dcfd651cfab70bf439101932f. The 73-case inventory retains the DeveloperTool-required behavior, efficiency, and stability dimensions. The six capability-control-plane cases now bind every claimed observable with discriminating controls: sweep grouping uses different-cause same-shape and same-presence split fixtures plus exact human/JSON correspondence; the agent_facing case includes a trait-absent control; stale WI evidence pins successful advisory routing; migration pins the complete relocated contract and forwarding-only README; claim reconciliation drives both authoritative health closure and copied producer inputs with exact missing/duplicate/misbound mappings; readiness executes a non-empty verifier, independently reproduces the Rust source digest, mutates actual source and command inputs, and checks every malformed/stale/zero-oracle blocker on both projections with no known_failure waiver. The concurrent workflow-root CLI chain case captures and executes three real emitted commands and distinguishes them from an exact clap-invalid negative control. These are independent black-box oracles over real aw processes and would fail for empty, constant-clean, presence-only, zero-test, or stale-evidence implementations.
